explanation.prose: Model and market disagree on LAA by 4.2pp — 44.7% fair against a 40.9% price. No individual baseball factor clears the bar for a headline here — this is not a single visible mismatch, it is the model pricing the side differently than the market. The main pushback is home field (~-1.1pp): TEX's home-field context weighs against the pick playing on the road. With a headwind that size, this is not a clean all-signal read. The market has drifted against the pick since posting, widening the available price — the current +147 still sits inside the playable range (to +146). This isn't a clean all-signal agreement — it's the model calling the posted number too generous for the true win probability.
